messages.subject: Rook app not running when launched from RStudio
messages.subject_clean: Rook app not running when launched from RStudio
messages.body_plain:
Running Rook 1.03 with R 2.14.2 and RStudio 0.95.262 on Mac OSX 10.7.3 with Safari 5.1.3

The following code

s <- Rhttpd$new()
s$start()
s$browse(1)

Leads to 'Safari open the page "http://127.0.0.1:0/custom/RookTest" because Safari can't connect to the server "12.0.0.1".

Whereas running the same in R via a terminal yields the Rook test app as expected.

Any suggestions?

Cheers,

Will

messages.subject_clean: Rook app not running when launched from RStudio
messages.body_plain:
After reading through that linked discussion, I can confirm that

  s$listenPort <- tools:::httpdPort

does fix my problem when running in RStudio Desktop.

Cheers,

Will
